content: अभि(भी)क {%a.%} [अभि-कन् निपातोऽयम्; <ls>P. V. 2. 74</ls>] .²1 Lustful, libidinous, voluptuous; सोऽधिकारमभिकः कुलोचितं काश्चन स्वयमवर्तयत्समाः <ls>R. 19. 4</ls>; अपि सिञ्चेः कृशानौ त्वं दर्पं मथ्यपि योऽभिकः <ls>Bk. 8. 92</ls>. .{@-कः@} A lover, voluptuous person.

अभीक {%a.%} [For <ab>ety.</ab> see अभिक] .²1 Longing after, desirous, anxious. .²2 Lustful, libidinous, voluptuous; मेदस्विनः सरभसोपगतानभीकान् <ls>Śi. 5. 64</ls>. .²3 Fearless. .²4 Gone to (अभिगत). .²5 Dreadful. .{@-कः@} .²1 A lover, husband. .²2 A poet. .²3 A master. <ab>cf.</ab> … अथ क्रूरे च कामुके . भयहीने कवौ पुंस्यादभीकः प्रोच्यते ततः .. <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-कम्@} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Proximity, nearness. .²2 Collision; combat, encounter, opposition; प्रावन्मनुं दस्यवे करभीकम् <ls>Rv. 9. 92. 5</ls>. [The form अभीके frequently occurs in the Vedas in the sense of .³({%a%}) near; .³({%b%}) at the same time or place, at the right time, just in time; .³({%c%}) in a moment, instantaneously, or (used like a preposition with <ab>abl.</ab>), .³({%d%}) from, out of; .³({%e%}) on account of, with regard to; .³({%f%}) from.]
